1:
Basic Skill
Max Lv : 9
Category : Passive
Allows use of basic interface-related functions.
[Lv 1] Trade
Enables item trading with other characters.
Right-click the character you wish to trade with to use.
[Lv 2] Emotion
Use Alt+0–9, Ctrl+1, -, =, and \ to perform emotions. Additional emotions can be used with Alt+L.
[Lv 3] Sit
Sit in place to increase HP recovery speed.
Use by pressing the Insert key or the /sit command.
[Lv 4] Chat Room
Allows creation of a chat room. Use with Alt+C.
[Lv 5] Join Party
Allows joining a party created by another player.
[Lv 6] Storage
Allows access to storage through a Kafra Employee.
[Lv 7] Create Party
Allows creation of a party.
Use with /create [Party Name]. Party options can be adjusted with Alt+Z.
[Lv 9] Job Change
Allows advancement to a first job class.
